root_cause_and_implementation: ReplayBackfillService gained a single new private const KNOWN_FIXTURE_CASES (the four existing case=>expected-outcome pairs, unchanged in content), now the one source of truth both execute()'s new pre-execution rejection and expectedOutcomeForFixtureCase() read from -- the two can never diverge into two different notions of 'known' because there is only one list. execute() now throws REPLAY_BACKFILL_UNKNOWN_FIXTURE_CASE (naming the offending value and the known set) as its very first action, before guardDateRange(), before any storage_path()/is_dir() filesystem check, before the calendar lookup, before the date loop -- matching C2's 'tolak sebelum bekerja; tidak memilih pointer atau menebak expected outcome' literally: no outcome is guessed, no partial work happens. expectedOutcomeForFixtureCase()'s own map lookup is otherwise unchanged; its '?? null' fallback is now unreachable dead-but-harmless code since execute() already rejects anything not in the map, left in place as a fail-closed default rather than removed, since removing it would require re-deriving what should happen if the two ever did diverge -- they cannot, by construction, so this is a non-issue. Separately, the known-case comparison logic itself ($observedOutcome === $expectedOutcome) required no change: it was re-verified, not assumed, that this strict-equality check already correctly fails for every one of the four current known cases when the actual observed outcome is the new NOT_ADMISSIBLE value E-MD-B18-A002-052 introduced, since NOT_ADMISSIBLE is not equal to MATCH, MISMATCH, or ERROR under strict string comparison -- proven directly with a mocked ReplayVerificationService returning exactly that shape for a reason_code_mismatch_case fixture. No current named fixture case expects BLOCKED/NOT_ADMISSIBLE (the map has only MATCH/MISMATCH/ERROR as values), so C2's negative-fixture-expects-BLOCKED row has no existing case to preserve here; inventing one was explicitly out of scope per instruction and not done. ReplayBackfillCommand.php was read and confirmed to pass --fixture_case straight through to execute() with no validation of its own, so this one change covers the only entry point besides direct service instantiation (which the test suite already exercises). Two targeted tests were added to the existing, previously two-method ReplayBackfillServiceTest.php: test_execute_rejects_an_unknown_fixture_case_before_any_work (Mockery shouldNotReceive on all four collaborators, proving zero work occurs, not merely that an exception is thrown) and test_execute_does_not_count_a_blocked_replay_as_passed_for_a_mismatch_expecting_case (a real-shaped mocked verifyRunAgainstFixture() return matching E-052's NOT_ADMISSIBLE/BLOCKED output, asserting passed=false, all_passed=false, and replay_status still BLOCKED in the persisted case). Both pre-existing tests were left completely unmodified and re-confirmed green, proving no regression to the already-covered paths (three-date all-matching success case; missing-publication error-and-stop case). Both new tests mutation-proven per governance protocol with byte-for-byte restore.
